 if r.get('figure_sha256')!=p['figures_sha256']:errors.append('figure map differs from section freeze')
 if r['reviewer_task'] in authors:errors.append('reviewer is neutral packet author')
 org=ref(e['original_report']);of=ref(e['original_section_freeze']);op=next(q for q in of['pages'] if q['page_id']==id);oraw=(root/op['snapshot']).read_bytes();assert sha(root/op['snapshot'])==op['source_sha256']
 earlier={}
 for s in e.get('original_source_snapshots',[]):
  ref(s['snapshot'],parse=False);dig=s['snapshot']['sha256'];assert any(x.get('kind')=='repository_code' and x.get('path')==s['source'] and x.get('sha256')==dig for x in org['sources']);earlier[s['source']]=[dig]
 oerrors=mod._validate(root,root/op['source'],id,oraw.decode(),org,{org['reviewer_task']:[id]},reader_tasks,{'files':earlier})
 current_created=r.get('created_at');original_created=org.get('created_at')
 times={'current_created_at':current_created,'original_created_at':original_created,'current_received_at':e['current_collection']['received_at'],'original_received_at':e['original_collection']['received_at']}
 assert datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(original_created)<=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(e['original_collection']['received_at'])
 assert datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(current_created)<=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(e['current_collection']['received_at'])
 assert datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(e['original_collection']['received_at'])<=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(e['current_collection']['received_at'])
 results.append({'lesson_id':id,'report':e['report'],'original_report':e['original_report'],'source_sha256':r['source_sha256'],'current_source_matches_section_freeze':r['source_sha256']==p['source_sha256'],'reviewer_task':r['reviewer_task'],'reviewer_context':r['reviewer_context'],'current_verdict':r['verdict'],'current_claims':len(r['claims']),'current_sources':len(r['sources']),'current_artifacts':len(r['artifacts']),'current_issues':len(r['issues']),'current_validation_errors':errors,'original_verdict':org['verdict'],'original_validation_errors':oerrors,'original_source_matches_original_freeze':org['source_sha256']==op['source_sha256'],'original_current_reviewer_same':org['reviewer_task']==r['reviewer_task'],'collection_times':times})
# Independently derive exact current G.1–G.4 slices from the canonical full body.
gp=next(p for p in canon['pages'] if p['page_id']=='glossary');graw=(root/gp['snapshot']).read_bytes();text=graw.decode();heads=list(re.finditer(r'^## (G\.[1-4])(?: |$)',text,re.M));slices=[]
for i,m in enumerate(heads):
 id=m.group(1);body=text[m.start():heads[i+1].start() if i+1<len(heads) else len(text)].encode();fp=root/pages[id]['snapshot'];assert body==fp.read_bytes()
 slices.append({'lesson_id':id,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(body),'current_report_source_sha256':current[id]['source_sha256'],'canonical_slice_exact':True})
ref(b['issue_inventory'],parse=False);ref(b['previous_bundle'],parse=False)
assert len(current)==26 and set(current)==set(pages)
assert len(owners)==26
